ProSiebenSat.1 Media Names Ingrid Heisserer as Finance Chief
ProSiebenSat.1 Media named Ingrid Heisserer as its next chief financial officer to succeed interim CFO Bob Rajan.
The German media company said Wednesday that Rajan, who has served as interim CFO since Oct. 21, will remain in that role until Heisserer's appointment on Feb. 1.

Heisserer has more than two decades of experience in senior finance leadership roles across international consumer goods and media companies, ProSiebenSat.1 said. She recently worked as CFO and chief human resources officer at RTL Deutschland.
